page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc6.16xlarge is a compute-optimized instance powered by the Intel Xeon 8269CY processor. Running on the KVM hypervisor, this x86_64 server features 64 dedicated physical cores and 64 vCPUs operating at a base clock speed of 3.1 GHz. It is equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB per core. The instance does not include local storage, relying instead on network-attached storage options, and features a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates strong multi-core performance, with a stress-ng multi-core CPU score of 61,243.12 and a strong multi-threaded bzip3 decompression rate of 269.5 GB/sec. The processor's support for AVX-512 and VNNI instructions contributes to a strong PassMark CPU extended instructions score of 57,136.8. Memory performance is also notable, showing strong read-only large block bandwidth at 209.21 GB/sec. However, LLM text generation speeds are weak, with the 7B model achieving 8.69 tokens per second, indicating limitations for real-time generative AI workloads without dedicated GPU acceleration.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.hfc6.16xlarge offers a high density of dedicated compute resources relative to its memory footprint, making it a viable option for CPU-bound workloads that do not require massive memory allocations. Strong performance in PassMark database operations and solid multi-core throughput make this instance well-suited for high-performance web serving, multi-threaded build systems, database operations, and parallelized data processing tasks.
